title: Using Astra to make a Rhythm game! Week 1 progress
author: Professional-Mark283
selftext:
I've always thought that the rhythm game genre is a really fun one! When I was younger, I really loved playing a rhythm game series called 'super guitar hero maniac deluxe' on Newgrounds.   
  
In that game series, you play as a stickman, who is playing on a guitar. The gameplay itself was pretty simple, just taps and holds. However, something really cool and unique that they did for their series, is that the bottom half of the screen would have the stickman react to the inputs you made at the top; if you pressed left, he would play an animation, if you pressed right, same thing, and getting higher combos would have [cooler animations play](https://imgur.com/a/ximiabp)

I thought it was a cool novelty and I plan on doing something similar! Currently waiting for my credits to refill but the gameplay of pressing and holding is already done, as well as being able to chart custom songs. So what's mostly left is just adding some more game juice.   
  
Not every song is gonna be lovey dovey like this one, it just happens to be the first test. I can imagine having multiple themes and characters in the future. Tell me if you also have any cool ideas or questions!
